description: Compute geometric golden [-4,+6°] and blue [-6,-4°] windows for one UTC day, 1900–2100. Sunrise at -0.833° is a separate convention. No refraction, terrain or weather. Numerical tolerance is not astronomical accuracy; oracle validation covers reference dates only. Shared solar models are not independent corroboration.

date_utc.description: Real Gregorian UTC midnight, year 1900–2100. Rust also validates month/day and leap years. Other hours are rejected, never truncated; this is not a local civil day.

name: plan_golden_hour
title: Golden and blue hour windows
